responsibility: Defines the user-visible C-SKY command-line options and maps them onto backend variables, masks, enums, and aliases used by GCC option processing. It covers cpu/arch selection, endianness, floating-point ABI and FPU choice, ISA-extension toggles passed through to assembly, and code-generation policy switches such as division, smart mode, high registers, push/pop, multiple load/store, constant pools, runtime selection, branch cost, and scheduler behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the C-SKY backend, listing -march/-mcpu/-mfpu and other -m switches and mapping them to backend variables, masks, enums, and aliases for GCC's option machinery. Unlike csky.cc it contains no target hook implementations, unlike csky.h it is not a header of target macros, and unlike csky.md it does not define RTL instruction patterns.
